# Metronome and tempo

The metronome is a patient teacher. I set it to a comfortable beat and play the passage once with perfect evenness before moving the dial. For fast sections the usual ladder is four clicks at a time: sixty, sixty-six, seventy-two and so on, with a drop back when mistakes appear.

Playing with the click also shows where I rush. Triplets against the beat, a held note across the bar line, the rest I tend to cut short: they are all revealed by the steady tick. For expressive music I switch the click off afterwards and let the rubato return, but only after the structure is secure.

Keep a small notebook with the tempo reached for each piece.
